messages.text: How do changes in Wi-Fi 7/8 technology affect the measurement capability required from Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer?

Short answer: Wi‑Fi 7 raises Signal Generator and Signal Analyzer needs to 320 MHz 802.11be bandwidth, 4096QAM-quality modulation/EVM, multi-RF-chain MIMO/MLO testing, and 6 GHz operation; Wi‑Fi 8 keeps the cited core PHY parameters at up to 7.125 GHz, 320 MHz, 4096QAM and MLO, while 480 MHz is only cited as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 waveform candidate, not a formal standard bandwidth [1][5][6][8][13].
| Area | Wi‑Fi 7 effect on SG/SA capability | Wi‑Fi 8 effect on SG/SA capability |
|---|---|---|
| Bandwidth | Wi‑Fi 7 includes 320 MHz channel bandwidth as a key throughput component, so SG/SA capability must cover 320 MHz 802.11be waveforms [1]. | Wi‑Fi 8 retains channel bandwidth up to 320 MHz in the cited core PHY parameters [5]. |
| Modulation | Wi‑Fi 7 uses 4096QAM as a key throughput component [1]. | Wi‑Fi 8 retains 4096QAM in the cited core PHY parameters [5]. |
| MIMO / spatial streams | Wi‑Fi 7 includes up to 16 spatial streams and MLO as throughput-related components [1]. | Wi‑Fi 8 retains MLO in the cited core PHY parameters [5]. |
| Practical MIMO test scaling | R&S CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined for 4x4 MIMO access-point testing [13]. | The passages do not provide a Wi‑Fi 8-specific CMP180 MIMO scaling specification. |
| Frequency bands | Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests cited for R&S CMX500 include the 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery [8]. | Wi‑Fi 8 supported frequencies are cited as up to 7.125 GHz [5]. |
| Instrument frequency coverage | R&S CMP180 is cited for Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [13]. | R&S CMP180 demonstrated loopback verification of a 480 MHz WLAN waveform as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn candidate, but this is not a formal Wi‑Fi 8 bandwidth specification [6][13]. |
【推論】For Wi‑Fi 7, the minimum cited SG/SA direction is 320 MHz 802.11be generation and analysis with 4096QAM-quality EVM, plus multi-RF-chain MIMO/MLO capability, because those are the cited Wi‑Fi 7 PHY and test-environment drivers [1][7][8][11][13].
【推論】For Wi‑Fi 8, the cited near-term SG/SA direction is to preserve Wi‑Fi 7-class 320 MHz, 4096QAM and MLO capability, while treating 480 MHz only as a candidate-waveform validation need unless a formal standard or datasheet is provided [5][6][13][19].

answer.question: How do changes in Wi-Fi 7 and Wi-Fi 8 technology affect the measurement capability required from Signal Generator and Signal Analyzer? Include requirements such as bandwidth, modulation/EVM, MIMO, puncturing/MRU, frequency bands, and any differences between Wi-Fi 7 and Wi-Fi 8.

passages.text:
Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術背景
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 列出的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] throughput-related components 包含：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 320 MHz channel bandwidth | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| up to 16 spatial streams | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| 4096 QAM modulation | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| [[MLO]] | key component；also key feature making multiple RF chains important |

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 提供 solution-level update：[[Bluetest]] earlier integrated WLAN testing capabilities 現在支援 [[Wi-Fi 7]] bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 則以背景段落描述 [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 是 next generation Wi-Fi technology，面向 extremely high data throughput、tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。

以上皆為來源對 Wi-Fi 7 與整合測試能力的敘述，不等同於 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]]、[[Bluetest]] RTS 或 [[EMITE]] chambers 對所有 feature combination 的完整規格保證。

Bluetest › 與 Rohde & Schwarz / R&S CMX500 的合作
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 說明，[[Bluetest]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box signaling tester 的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality 整合進 [[Bluetest Flow]] control software，使 [[WLAN]] developers 可使用 [[Bluetest]] reverberation chamber technology 開發 advanced WLAN stations 與 access points。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步說明，[[Bluetest]] 已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 4G 與 [[5G NR]] test functionality 整合進 [[Bluetest Flow]] v1.18，並將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality 擴充為支援 320 MHz bandwidth。此來源將整合後的能力描述為可在 [[Bluetest]] RTS 中使用單一 tester 與 reverberation test system 驗證 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance。

來源中的 [[Kjell Olovsson]] 引言稱，將 [[R&S CMX500]] one-box tester 整合到 [[Bluetest Flow]] broadens Bluetest 的 WLAN testing capabilities，並可為 latest Wi-Fi 7 devices 提供 testing environment。

來源中的 [[Karl-Johan Holm]] 引言稱，[[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 與 [[Bluetest Flow]] 讓 developers 可在 Bluetest reverberation chambers 中從 WiFi 到 LTE 與 5G SA/NSA 驗證 radio and antenna performance，且此 path 是 end-to-end、fast、repeatable。

⚠️ [[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]]（來源未標示發布日期；raw created 2026-09-11）說 Bluetest CEO 是 [[Karl-Johan Holm]]，但既有頁面 [[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 說 Bluetest CEO 是 [[Kjell Olovsson]]。兩份來源皆未標示新聞稿發布日期且 raw created 同為 2026-09-11，無法判斷哪一個較新；並列保留，不推論職務變動。

Wi-Fi over mmWave Technology › 測試需求
依 [[R&S for JIO Project]] 與 [[R&S solution for Jio project_202509_r3]]，WoMT 測試至少包含：

- OTA precision measurement：使用 [[R&S ATS1800C]] CATR chamber。
- TX analysis：[[EIRP]]、[[TRP]]、[[ACLR]]、EVM under Wi-Fi 7 modulation。
- RX analysis：[[EIS]] sensitivity verification。
- Spurious：Rx / OOB spurious emissions monitoring。
- Occupied bandwidth。
- Native Wi-Fi / IF / IB band：[[R&S CMP180]]。
- mmWave signal generation and analysis：[[R&S CMP200]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]]。
- R&D fine tuning：[[R&S FSW67]] 與 signal sources。
- Production / manufacturing setup：[[R&S CMQ200]] 與 automation SW WMT 只作為來源列名，尚無詳細流程。

R&S ATS1800C › 來源中的定位
依 [[GFM325_0e_5G_NR_BaseStation_OTA_RX_Tests]]（06.2020）：

- [[R&S ATS1800C]] 是 CATR based 5G NR mmWave test chamber。
- 在 OTA base station receiver tests 中，ATS1800C 適用 FR2。
- Source abbreviations 中簡稱 `ATS1800C`。
- 來源的 OTA antenna test solution applicability table 中，FR2 ATS1800C 適用於 7.2 OTA sensitivity、7.3 OTA reference sensitivity level、7.4 OTA dynamic range、7.5.1 OTA adjacent channel selectivity、7.5.2 OTA in-band blocking、7.8 OTA receiver intermodulation 與 7.9 OTA in-channel selectivity。
- 7.6 OTA out-of-band blocking 與 7.7 OTA receiver spurious emissions 在 FR2 ATS1800C 欄位標示為 `TBC`。
- Ordering information：Compact antenna test range OTA test system，Order No. `1534.1800.02`。

依 [[MWC2025---WIC-INFRA]]（MWC 2025 Barcelona；raw converted 2026-09-17）：

- [[R&S ATS1800C]] 被列為 `Solutions for OTA testing` 中的 RF Performance at Small Test Chamber Footprints solution。
- 來源將其定位為 FR2 compact test system with a high-quality quiet zone。
- Slide 8 同頁列出 Ø 30 cm Quiet zone、high shielding effective chamber with IFF（indirect far-field）solution。
- Slide 26 的 densification / small cells / RF design and compliance portfolio 也列出 [[R&S ATS1800C]]。

Wi-Fi 8 › 延續自 Wi-Fi 7 的 core PHY parameters
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]，[[Wi-Fi 8]] 保留下列 [[Wi-Fi 7]] core physical layer parameters：

| 項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| supported frequencies | up to 7.125 GHz |
| channel bandwidth | up to 320 MHz |
| modulation | 4096QAM |
| multi-link | [[MLO]] |

以上是 PR 中對 Wi-Fi 8 的簡述，不等同於完整 IEEE 802.11bn normative specification。

Wi-Fi 8 › 480 MHz waveform candidate 說法
[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 稱：

- [[R&S CMP180]] supports bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] will demonstrate its ability to verify a [[WLAN]] waveform with **480 MHz bandwidth** in loopback mode。
- 該 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] standard。

此說法目前只能作為 MWC 2024 PR 的 candidate / discussion 記錄；不得推論 480 MHz 已成為 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 標準通道頻寬。

R&S CMP180 › Selected measurement performance
依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：

Short answer: Wi‑Fi 7 raises Signal Generator and Signal Analyzer needs to 320 MHz 802.11be bandwidth, 4096QAM-quality modulation/EVM, multi-RF-chain MIMO/MLO testing, and 6 GHz operation; Wi‑Fi 8 keeps the cited core PHY parameters at up to 7.125 GHz, 320 MHz, 4096QAM and MLO, while 480 MHz is only cited as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 waveform candidate, not a formal standard bandwidth [1][5][6][8][13].
| Area | Wi‑Fi 7 effect on SG/SA capability | Wi‑Fi 8 effect on SG/SA capability |
|---|---|---|
| Bandwidth | Wi‑Fi 7 includes 320 MHz channel bandwidth as a key throughput component, so SG/SA capability must cover 320 MHz 802.11be waveforms [1]. | Wi‑Fi 8 retains channel bandwidth up to 320 MHz in the cited core PHY parameters [5]. |
| Modulation | Wi‑Fi 7 uses 4096QAM as a key throughput component [1]. | Wi‑Fi 8 retains 4096QAM in the cited core PHY parameters [5]. |
| MIMO / spatial streams | Wi‑Fi 7 includes up to 16 spatial streams and MLO as throughput-related components [1]. | Wi‑Fi 8 retains MLO in the cited core PHY parameters [5]. |
| Practical MIMO test scaling | R&S CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports for single-box 2x2 MIMO testing, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined for 4x4 MIMO access-point testing [13]. | The passages do not provide a Wi‑Fi 8-specific CMP180 MIMO scaling specification. |
| Frequency bands | Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests cited for R&S CMX500 include the 6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery [8]. | Wi‑Fi 8 supported frequencies are cited as up to 7.125 GHz [5]. |
| Instrument frequency coverage | R&S CMP180 is cited for Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [13]. | R&S CMP180 demonstrated loopback verification of a 480 MHz WLAN waveform as a potential Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn candidate, but this is not a formal Wi‑Fi 8 bandwidth specification [6][13]. |
【推論】For Wi‑Fi 7, the minimum cited SG/SA direction is 320 MHz 802.11be generation and analysis with 4096QAM-quality EVM, plus multi-RF-chain MIMO/MLO capability, because those are the cited Wi‑Fi 7 PHY and test-environment drivers [1][7][8][11][13].
【推論】For Wi‑Fi 8, the cited near-term SG/SA direction is to preserve Wi‑Fi 7-class 320 MHz, 4096QAM and MLO capability, while treating 480 MHz only as a candidate-waveform validation need unless a formal standard or datasheet is provided [5][6][13][19].

cited_passages.text:
Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術背景
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 列出的 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] throughput-related components 包含：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| 320 MHz channel bandwidth | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| up to 16 spatial streams | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| 4096 QAM modulation | key component facilitating higher throughput |
| [[MLO]] | key component；also key feature making multiple RF chains important |

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 提供 solution-level update：[[Bluetest]] earlier integrated WLAN testing capabilities 現在支援 [[Wi-Fi 7]] bandwidth up to **320 MHz**。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 則以背景段落描述 [[IEEE 802.11be]] / [[Wi-Fi 7]] 是 next generation Wi-Fi technology，面向 extremely high data throughput、tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。

以上皆為來源對 Wi-Fi 7 與整合測試能力的敘述，不等同於 [[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S CMX500 OBT]]、[[Bluetest Flow]]、[[Bluetest]] RTS 或 [[EMITE]] chambers 對所有 feature combination 的完整規格保證。

Wi-Fi 8 › 延續自 Wi-Fi 7 的 core PHY parameters
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz and Broadcom showcase first Wi-Fi 8 RF signaling tests, paving way for next-gen connectivity]]，[[Wi-Fi 8]] 保留下列 [[Wi-Fi 7]] core physical layer parameters：

| 項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| supported frequencies | up to 7.125 GHz |
| channel bandwidth | up to 320 MHz |
| modulation | 4096QAM |
| multi-link | [[MLO]] |

以上是 PR 中對 Wi-Fi 8 的簡述，不等同於完整 IEEE 802.11bn normative specification。

Wi-Fi 8 › 480 MHz waveform candidate 說法
[[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 稱：

- [[R&S CMP180]] supports bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] will demonstrate its ability to verify a [[WLAN]] waveform with **480 MHz bandwidth** in loopback mode。
- 該 480 MHz waveform 被稱為 potential waveform candidate for the yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] standard。

此說法目前只能作為 MWC 2024 PR 的 candidate / discussion 記錄；不得推論 480 MHz 已成為 [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 標準通道頻寬。

R&S CMP180 › Selected measurement performance
依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：

| Option | 功能 | 規格摘錄 |
|---|---|---|
| R&S CMP-KM600 | 5G NR analyzer | EVM FR1 bandwidth 100 MHz, SCS 30 kHz, 16QAM, level > –20 dBm：< 0.5% |
| R&S CMP-KM305 | UWB production measurements | center frequency offset < 0.005 ppm；chip clock error < 0.02 ppm；NRMSE < 5%；relative AVG pulse level < 0.1 dB |
| R&S CMP-KM351 | WLAN IEEE 802.11ax analyzer | bandwidth 160 MHz < –46 dB meas.；with R&S CMP-KB805 < –49 dB meas. |
| R&S CMP-KW351 | WLAN IEEE 802.11ax generator | bandwidth 160 MHz < –45 dB |
| R&S CMP-KM352 | WLAN IEEE 802.11be analyzer | 160 MHz < –46 dB meas.；with R&S CMP-KB805 < –49 dB meas.；320 MHz < –46 dB meas.；320 MHz with R&S CMP-KB805 < –48 dB meas. |
| R&S CMP-KW352 | WLAN IEEE 802.11be generator | 160 MHz < –45 dB；320 MHz < –43 dB |

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 OTA MIMO stress testing › 為什麼需要 OTA 與 multiple RF chains
[[Bluetest and Rohde & Schwarz collaborate to offer over-the-air testing of next-generation WLAN devices]] 指出，在 WLAN devices development 期間，需要在 real-world conditions in signaling mode 下量測 antennas 以及 RF transmitter / receiver characteristics。由於 [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很關鍵。

同一來源同時將 [[R&S CMX500]] 描述為 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester；其 flexibility、support for multiple radio technologies 與 embedded IP test capabilities 使其可用於 broad range of Wi-Fi 7-specific tests。

[[Bluetest reverberation test solutions now support 4G, 5G NR, and WLAN over-the-air tests with Rohde & Schwarz CMX500 OBT]] 進一步把 Wi-Fi 7 OTA 測試放入更廣的 [[4G 5G NR WLAN OTA MIMO stress testing]] 情境：同一 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] / [[Bluetest]] RTS workflow 同時涵蓋 WiFi、[[LTE]]、5G SA / NSA 的 radio and antenna performance validation。

[[EMITE and Rohde & Schwarz join forces to support OTA measurements on Wi-Fi 7 and 5G RedCap]] 沒有使用 MIMO stress testing 一詞，也沒有提供 RF chains、spatial streams 或 chamber reflection model；它的貢獻是確認另一個 OTA chamber vendor [[EMITE]] 也將 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合到 [[Wi-Fi 7]] OTA measurement solution 中。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › 使用限制
- 本頁目前只由 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]] 支撐。
- 來源是 PR / demonstration positioning，不是正式 datasheet、configuration guide、test case list 或 certification document。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMX500]] Wi‑Fi 7 的 option code、software release、支援 RF chains 數量、MLO link combination、measurement uncertainty 或完整 test coverage。
- 不可從本來源推論 [[R&S CMP180]] 480 MHz waveform 的正式 [[Wi-Fi 8]] 標準地位、量測規格或 production throughput。
